title: Montreal anti-capitalist May Day march
location: Parc Madeleine-Parent, Pointe-Saint-Charles, through Atwater Market and Atwater Avenue, Montreal, Quebec
organizer: Organizers of traditional anti-capitalist May Day march; named organizers not stated
participants_original: About one hundred participants initially gathered.
threshold_50_evidence: Journal de Montréal reports about 100 assembled before departure, supporting ≥50 at this gathering.

start_date.summary: Article states Monday, May 1, 2023, march set off around 19:50.

location.summary: Assembly at Parc Madeleine-Parent, then march through Atwater Market and up Atwater Avenue.

protester_violence.summary: Police spokesperson cited property damage to vehicles/shopfronts, smoke devices and bins thrown into street.

state_response.summary: Police used chemical irritants to disperse march at about 20:15; immediate arrest tally unavailable.

demands.summary: Report describes an anti-capitalist march but does not specify a concrete demand directed to government/state policy.

notes: Occurrence, threshold, date, location and dispersal supported, but anti-capitalist label does not establish demand on own-country state/policy. TVA result is not counted as independent confirmation because relationship is unknown.
open_questions: Did organizers make a specific demand to a Canadian or Quebec public authority?

title: Halifax school-support workers strike and public pickets
location: Halifax, Nova Scotia; June continuation report describes Province House, Armdale Roundabout, Grand Parade and Macdonald Bridge area
scope: local strike with multiple public picket/mobilization sites
participants_original: More than 1,800 school support workers went on strike May 10; later public gathering described as hundreds of picketers, parents, students and supporters (June 6).
threshold_50_evidence: June 6 follow-up reports hundreds in a picket gathering; does not establish that the first gathering at strike onset on May 10 reached 50.

start_date.summary: June report says over 1,800 workers went on strike May 10 after rejecting tentative agreement.

participants.summary: Worker count is strike membership, not May 10 attendance; report separately documents hundreds picketing at a June 6 gathering.

demands.summary: Union sought a living wage and wage increases; provincial government was party to the rejected tentative agreement.

location.summary: Follow-up documents June 6 demonstrations at Province House and other Halifax locations; May 10 first public assembly location/date unverified.

notes: A strike began May 10, but retrieved evidence does not establish that a ≥50 public gathering occurred on the onset date; do not backdate June 6 turnout. June actions are recorded as continuation of the May-onset labor episode.
open_questions: Contemporaneous May evidence for first public picketing date and attendance; exact end date.
